motions.item_title: Authority to move into closed meeting
motions.text: That the Council of the City of Guelph now hold a meeting that is closed to the public, pursuant to the Municipal Act, to consider: Comprehensive Zoning By-law Appeals - Ontario Land Tribunal Update - 2026-35 As per Section 239(2)(e) and (f) of the Municipal Act, regarding litigation or potential litigation, including matters before administrative tribunals, affecting the municipality or local board and advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose.

motions.item_title: 44 Edinburgh Road North - Notice of Intention to Designate - 2026-20
motions.text: That the City Clerk be authorized to publish and serve notice of intention to designate 44 Edinburgh Road North pursuant to Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act. That the Heritage Advisory Committee advises City Council that the committee supports the heritage attributes recommended in the staff report titled “44 Edinburgh Road North – Draft Council Designation Report” and dated January 15, 2026.
motions.text_html:
1. That the City Clerk be authorized to publish and serve notice of intention to designate 44 Edinburgh Road North pursuant to Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act.
  2. That the Heritage Advisory Committee advises City Council that the committee supports the heritage attributes recommended in the staff report titled “44 Edinburgh Road North – Draft Council Designation Report” and dated January 15, 2026.

motions.item_title: Designation of Ontario Reformatory Heritage Conservation District - 2026-43
motions.name: Main Motion
motions.text: That City Council, in accordance with Section 41 of the Ontario Heritage Act, designate by by-law the area shown in Attachment-1 of this report, as the Ontario Reformatory Heritage Conservation District. That City Council adopt by by-law the Ontario Reformatory Heritage Conservation District Plan and Guidelines (Attachment-2) as the district plan for the Ontario Reformatory Heritage Conservation District.
motions.text_html:
1. That City Council, in accordance with Section 41 of the Ontario Heritage Act, designate by by-law the area shown in Attachment-1 of this report, as the Ontario Reformatory Heritage Conservation District.
  2. That City Council adopt by by-law the Ontario Reformatory Heritage Conservation District Plan and Guidelines (Attachment-2) as the district plan for the Ontario Reformatory Heritage Conservation District.

motions.name: Amendment to Main Motion
motions.text: That staff remove mentions and provisions for residential development from the Ontario Reformatory Heritage Conservation District Plan and Guidelines included as Attachment-2 of the staff report. That staff bring the amended Ontario Reformatory Heritage Conservation District Plan and Guidelines and subsequent bylaw to a future Council meeting for approval.
